company: 日本ビルファンド投資法人

latest_post.summary: MSCI11月入替で日本株は採用なし、ANAHD・大東建託・阪急阪神HD・日本ビルファンド・日産が除外。ほぼ予定通りとの報告。
latest_post.summary_en: Report that in the November MSCI rebalance, no Japanese stocks were added, and ANA HD, Daito Trust Construction, Hankyu Hanshin HD, Nippon Building Fund, and Nissan were excluded, which was almost as expected.
